description:
Title: DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen

A nifty online tool helps you with repairing your Smartphone on your own.
You start by entering the model and what is broken.
The tool gives you the list of materials, the list of tools, and (for each part) several ordering choices.
Some stuff you already have (e.g. some tools, screws).
The tool also lets you contact friends if you can borrow / buy something for cheap from them.
The rest you buy.
Afterwards you receive instructions how to fix your phone.
If it worked, send a review and/or video of you fixing it.
If it hasn't worked out, you can send it to an expert.

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_07" sourceRef="User_ContactFriends" targetRef="User_FriendsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_08" sourceRef="User_FriendsMerge" targetRef="User_BuyRemaining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_09" sourceRef="User_BuyRemaining" targetRef="User_RequestInstructions"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_13" name="Worked" sourceRef="User_RepairOutcome" targetRef="User_FeedbackSplit">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_17" sourceRef="User_SendReview" targetRef="User_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_18" sourceRef="User_SendVideo" targetRef="User_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_19" sourceRef="User_FeedbackJoin" targetRef="User_EndSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_20" sourceRef="User_SendToExpert" targetRef="User_EndExpert"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineTool" name="Online repair tool" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Tool_Start" name="Phone details received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Tool_StartMessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_PhoneDetails"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Tool_SendLists" name="Provide materials, tools, and ordering choices" messageRef="Message_ListsAndChoices"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Tool_ReceiveInstructionRequest" name="Receive request for repair instructions" messageRef="Message_InstructionRequest"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Tool_ProvideInstructions" name="Provide repair instructions"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Tool_SendInstructions" name="Send repair instructions" messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Tool_End" name="Instructions sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="T_Flow_01" sourceRef="Tool_Start" targetRef="Tool_GenerateLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="T_Flow_02" sourceRef="Tool_GenerateLists" targetRef="Tool_SendLists"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="T_Flow_04" sourceRef="Tool_ReceiveInstructionRequest" targetRef="Tool_ProvideInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="T_Flow_05" sourceRef="Tool_ProvideInstructions" targetRef="Tool_SendInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="T_Flow_06" sourceRef="Tool_SendInstructions" targetRef="Tool_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Video" sourceRef="User_SendVideo" targetRef="Participant_Tool" messageRef="Message_RepairVideo"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Expert" sourceRef="User_SendToExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert" messageRef="Message_PhoneForExpert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
